_comment: Pinned measurements for the NEAR AI Cloud attestation check (AIR-303 review). Every report is rejected unless its Intel-verified MRTD, RTMR0 to RTMR2 and compose hash are listed here; a missing list fails the check, nothing is skipped.
_source: Seeded 2026-11-03 from the report whose record is runtime/recordings/attest/z-ai_glm-5.3-flash.json (report sha256 67ec4a9438c678c55aa3f1a7cbd7b21bfc1749bec8950a088732ccd03ddffb56): values read from the DCAP-verified quotes and equal to info.tcb_info of the same report.
_rotate: NEAR AI redeploys images, so a later report with new values fails with the row os_measurements or compose_pin. Review it first: run `pnpm -C runtime attest`, read the failing row, check the new compose and image digests against NEAR's published image provenance (docs.near.ai cloud/verification/cloud-api/image-provenance) and release notes, then ADD the new values next to the old ones in a reviewed commit and remove the old ones once they no longer serve. Never edit this file from the runtime. The reviewed way to add a build is `pnpm -C runtime attest-rotate <compose_hash> --reason "<why>"`: it refuses unless a fresh report for that compose hash passes every other check, then appends the date, report sha256 and reason to `_rotate_log`.
